summary.text: Stacey Guerin is a Republican member of the Maine State Senate representing District 4 who is not seeking re-election to the Senate and is instead the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists James McClymer (D) as her opponent.

paragraphs.text: Stacey Guerin was born in Kenduskeag, Maine, and lives in Glenburn, Maine.
Her career experience includes co-owning R.M. Flagg Co., Food Service Equipment, and working as a second grade teacher at Eddington Elementary School.
She has served on the board of directors of Hospitality Maine and as a director of Women in Government.
Guerin served in the Maine House of Representatives for District 102 from 2010 to 2018, including on the Judiciary Committee, where she was ranking minority member in 2015.
She then joined the Maine State Senate, where Ballotpedia lists her as representing District 4 and as having assumed office on December 6, 2022.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee and the Bills in Second Reading Committee.
